name: v6_ladder
description: Closes the measured gap to the top-20 ladder rather than to our own previous agent. From 238 winning ladder games: they buy animals on day 0 (we waited 11), hold ~12 hands to the end (we drop to 7.5), expand land 4 days earlier, and grow strawberry over wheat 5:1 (we do the reverse). Median ladder bank 115k vs our 68k.
